description: Portable steel A-frame police road barrier with a red-and-white striped horizontal rail panel bearing the Royal Thai Police badge and the word ตำรวจ.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Portable steel A-frame road barrier with two folding tubular legs at each end, one wide horizontal sheet-steel panel between them painted in diagonal red and white stripes, a circular Royal Thai Police badge centred on the panel with the Thai word ตำรวจ in bold white letters beside it Materials: Glossy enamel stripes chipped at the edges, galvanised tube legs scuffed and rust-spotted at the feet, sun-faded red.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Fully synthetic. No third-party scanned or scraped geometry.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.90. 652/2,000 triangles, 2/2 draw calls, 2/2 materials, 2/4 unique geometries, one 256 px canvas and one 20 KB baked map.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 1.50 x 1.10 x 0.66 m (depth corrected from 0.55 between the proxy's 0.84 and the plate's ~0.6 of leg height). Panel 0.48-1.08 with its TOP at the leg tops as the proxy's rows 0.46-0.98 and the plate's bare tube ends at the panel corners both say; v1 hung a 0.48 panel from 0.56 under a visible top bar with 0.06 of air above it. Legs at the extreme columns just outside the 1.44 panel, brace at 0.24, stays from the brace joints to the panel foot at x +-0.50.
featureReviews.notes: The proxy's w:h 1.648 is not followed: a yaw-corrected plate reads ~1.3, and the standard barrier is 1.5 m long.

featureReviews.evidence: Field tones MEASURED off the plate's own panel (median red #b0423a over 100k pixels, white #dfdfde over 56k); bars at 60 degrees on a 210 px pitch with a rounded red clear band across the middle as the plate lays it out; the badge with its staff and ตำรวจ are the plate's pixels with the red keyed to alpha and masked to the print zones -- decoded in the harness (texturesPending 0).
featureReviews.notes: v1 pasted the crop as a feathered rectangle whose grimy red never matched the drawn red and read as a sticker; the crop is not rectified, so the wordmark keeps the plate's slight skew.

featureReviews.evidence: Zinc #9a9c9c tubes with a rust canvas; rust as coaxial tube SLEEVES in the plate's dull brown (#6f5c4a feet, #857a6c joint bloom) at the feet, brace joints and open apexes, replacing v1's six orange blocks; four bolt heads where the panel meets the legs.

name: Police Traffic Barrier
nameTh: แผงกั้นจราจรตำรวจ
notes: The most common road barricade in Thailand: checkpoint, festival closure, accident scene. Repeats in rows of five to ten, so it is a small, cheap prop. Not breakable; a single rigid A-frame. The badge and lettering are a printed graphic and belong on a canvas, not in geometry. DEPTH CORRECTED 2026-09-02 from 0.55 m to 0.66 m; width 1.50 and height 1.10 unchanged. The Meshy proxy reads d/h 0.762 (0.84 m at 1.10) with the feet at 0.007-0.755 of its height, and the plate near A-frame spreads its feet about 0.6 of the leg height; 0.66 sits between the two readings (a 1.10 m A-frame with legs splayed 17 degrees each side). The proxy w/h of 1.648 is not followed: the plate reads the whole barrier near 1.3 wide per unit height once the yaw is allowed for, so 1.50 x 1.10 stands.
